name: io.github.raksa/khmer-lint-mcp
title: Khmer Lint
description: Khmer text tools: spellcheck, word segmentation, zero-width fixes, NiDA keyboard conversions.

environmentVariables.name: KHMER_LINT_MCP_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the file tools may use, besides the client's roots — a path list (':'-separated; ';' on Windows). With neither, the working directory.

environmentVariables.name: KHMER_LINT_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to never write a file: edits return the new text instead.

environmentVariables.name: KHMER_LINT_MCP_CUSTOM_WORDS
environmentVariables.description: A text file holding the custom dictionary, one word per line; created on the first addition.

environmentVariables.name: KHMER_LINT_MCP_DICTIONARY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: A folder with km_KH.aff, km_KH.dic and km_KH-suggest.aff to use instead of the bundled dictionaries.
